task: Basic Package Preparation and Sealing Procedure
description: Assessment of observable steps performed during a basic package preparation and sealing procedure.

criteria.name: Package Preparation
criteria.description: Learner prepares the package or box before placing the item.

criteria.name: Item Preparation
criteria.description: Learner has the item ready for packaging.

criteria.name: Item Placement
criteria.description: Learner places the item inside the package.

criteria.name: Package Closure
criteria.description: Learner closes the package after placing the item.

criteria.name: Package Sealing
criteria.description: Learner applies sealing material to complete the package.
